obligations.expected_behavior: The detached positive Probe must pass and independently bind its input, actual target, command, result, and output evidence.
forbidden_result: A detached positive Probe fails or has no passing terminal result.
A positive Probe is accepted without independently bound input, actual target, command, result, and output evidence.
obligations.observable_result: Machine-verifiable Probe evidence records a passing positive Probe with independently bound input, actual target, command, result, and output.
obligations.state_after: The positive Probe has passed with its complete independent execution bindings.
obligations.state_before: A detached positive Probe has not yet established a passing result with complete independent execution bindings.
obligations.subject: Positive Probe oracle
obligations.trigger: A detached positive Probe is executed.

obligations.expected_behavior: Each Probe must independently bind its actual target, command, result, and output evidence.
forbidden_result: A Probe lacks an independently bound actual target, command, result, or output evidence.
A Probe reuses another execution's target, command, result, or output evidence as its own binding.
obligations.observable_result: Each Probe receipt contains independently attributable actual-target, command, result, and output bindings.
obligations.state_after: Every Probe has complete independently attributable execution bindings.
obligations.state_before: Probe execution bindings have not been independently established.
obligations.subject: Probe identity and execution receipt

obligations.expected_behavior: A Candidate must not select the Validator Capability identity or establish its own trust.
forbidden_result: A Candidate selects the Validator Capability identity.
Candidate-controlled identity or trust establishes Validator Capability trust.
obligations.observable_result: Validator Capability trust is rejected when its identity selection or trust establishment is candidate-controlled.
obligations.state_after: Validator Capability identity and trust remain candidate-external.
obligations.state_before: Validator Capability identity or trust is offered from Candidate-controlled selection or establishment.
obligations.subject: Validator Capability selection
obligations.trigger: Validator Capability identity or trust is established for evaluation.

obligations.expected_behavior: Validator version text alone must never establish trust.
forbidden_result: Descriptive validator version text alone establishes trust.
Validator trust is accepted without the required content and dependency bindings.
obligations.observable_result: A trust decision based only on validator version text is rejected.
obligations.state_after: Validator trust is not established from version text alone.
obligations.state_before: Validator version text is presented as trust evidence.
obligations.subject: Validator version evidence

obligations.expected_behavior: Every retained evaluation seed must use only `anchor_candidate`, `challenge_candidate`, or `non_baseline_exploratory_candidate` classification.
forbidden_result: A retained evaluation seed uses a classification outside `anchor_candidate`, `challenge_candidate`, or `non_baseline_exploratory_candidate`.
A retained evaluation seed is accepted with no classification.
obligations.observable_result: Each retained evaluation seed has one of the three allowed classifications, and any other or missing classification is rejected.
obligations.state_after: All retained evaluation seeds use only the closed allowed classification set.
obligations.state_before: A retained evaluation seed classification has not been validated against the closed allowed set.
obligations.subject: Evaluation-seed classification
obligations.trigger: A retained evaluation seed is recorded or validated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Stable eligibility requires a verifiable provenance reference for source-supported existing behavior, and a temporary package must not qualify merely because it differs from Candidate.
forbidden_result: A Stable Package has no verifiable provenance reference for source-supported existing behavior.
A temporary package qualifies as Stable merely because it differs from Candidate.
obligations.observable_result: Stable eligibility is rejected unless source-supported existing behavior has a verifiable provenance reference; a merely different temporary package is rejected.
obligations.state_after: The Stable Package is eligible only through verifiable provenance for source-supported existing behavior.
obligations.state_before: A proposed Stable Package has not established verifiable provenance for source-supported existing behavior.
obligations.subject: Stable Package eligibility
obligations.trigger: A package is evaluated for Stable eligibility.

obligations.expected_behavior: Candidate must contain the real change under evaluation.
forbidden_result: A Candidate that does not contain the real change under evaluation is accepted for comparison.
obligations.observable_result: Candidate identity and content establish that it contains the real change under evaluation.
obligations.state_after: The Candidate contains the real change under evaluation.
obligations.state_before: A Candidate has been proposed without establishing that it contains the real change under evaluation.
obligations.subject: Candidate Package eligibility
obligations.trigger: A Candidate Package is admitted to matrix evaluation.

obligations.expected_behavior: The Consumer Manifest must be non-empty and frozen before review.
forbidden_result: An empty Consumer Manifest is accepted.
A Consumer Manifest is frozen after review begins.
A Consumer Manifest remains mutable during review.
obligations.observable_result: A non-empty version-bound Consumer Manifest is frozen before review.
obligations.state_after: A non-empty Consumer Manifest is frozen before review.
obligations.state_before: The Consumer Manifest has not yet been frozen before review.
obligations.subject: Consumer Manifest lifecycle
obligations.trigger: The Consumer Manifest is prepared for review.

obligations.expected_behavior: Each Consumer must bind its actual interface, input, command, output, result, and dependencies.
forbidden_result: A Consumer lacks a binding for its actual interface, input, command, output, result, or dependencies.
A Consumer is accepted using inferred rather than actual interface or execution bindings.
obligations.observable_result: Each Consumer receipt records its actual interface, input, command, output, result, and dependencies.
obligations.state_after: Every Consumer has complete actual execution and dependency bindings.
obligations.state_before: Consumer execution and dependency bindings have not been completely established.
obligations.subject: Consumer execution receipt

obligations.expected_behavior: Each behavioral obligation requires its own observable fault witness, and every other obligation requires a deterministic violation witness.
forbidden_result: A behavioral obligation lacks its own observable fault witness.
A non-behavioral obligation lacks a deterministic violation witness.
A witness is treated as covering an obligation without independently proving that obligation.
obligations.observable_result: Exact Cover records an observable fault witness for each behavioral obligation and a deterministic violation witness for every other obligation.
obligations.state_after: Every obligation has the required independently attributable witness type.
obligations.state_before: Obligation witness type and per-obligation attribution have not been verified.
obligations.subject: Atomic Obligation witness requirements

obligations.expected_behavior: Budget exhaustion must be unsuccessful and must never reduce coverage.
forbidden_result: Budget exhaustion is accepted as successful.
Budget exhaustion reduces required coverage.
Reduced coverage is accepted because a time or output budget was exhausted.
obligations.observable_result: Budget exhaustion produces an unsuccessful terminal result while required coverage remains unchanged.
obligations.state_after: An exhausted execution budget is unsuccessful without reducing coverage.
obligations.state_before: An external process or aggregate run reaches its execution budget.
obligations.subject: Bounded-execution coverage
obligations.trigger: An external process or aggregate run exhausts its time or output budget.
